description: MainActivity Java source file for an Android app implementing tab navigation with fragment instantiation and tab listener logic.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity extending TabCompatActivity, manages tab setup and contains nested classes for tab listener and fragments.

classes.name: MainActivity.InstantiatingTabListener
classes.description: Implements tab listener to instantiate and manage fragment transactions when tabs are selected, unselected, or reselected.

classes.name: MainActivity.PhotosFragment
classes.description: Fragment that displays a TextView for the Photos tab.

classes.name: MainActivity.VideosFragment
classes.description: Fragment that displays a TextView for the Videos tab.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and adds 'photos' and 'videos' tabs with associated fragments.

methods.name: InstantiatingTabListener
methods.description: Constructor to set activity context and fragment class for tab instantiation.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles tab selection: creates and adds fragment if not yet instantiated or attaches existing fragment.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Detaches the fragment when its tab is unselected.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: No operation, as reselecting an active tab does not change UI.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates a simple TextView with centered text displaying the tab label, for both PhotosFragment and VideosFragment.
